items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: some beautiful people like Eddie Miller and -- well, I shant go into the names because there were so many

ctx.x: And the third year in Aspen, he asked me and Jack Lesberg, and I suggested a bunch of names that possibly he might add, the musicians, so the groups got larger. So he got

a whole bunch of musicians from the coast, and some beautiful people like Eddie Miller and -- well, I shant go into the names because there were so many, as the parties grew, and I have every set -- Richard used to write out the sets of all the musicians who would be following each other on the bandstand, and I have every one from back in '62. I rather think that I'm the only person who has preserved all those things.

But we don't have time on these tapes to go through all the personnel. The fourth year or so, he decided for a change of scenery, and the guest list was growing larger and larger, and in fact, the parties were, as I say, the guest list was larger, and the party gained prominence around the country by heresay, and everybody was clam pring to get on that guest list, and Dick had to screen whoever he wanted, and he was allowing the real jazz bands that could afford to make the trip and come out, he was adding them…
